title: Tableau block base
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $n$ and $t$ be natural numbers. The base index of tableau block $t$ is $n+2+tW$, where $W$ is the tableau width of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
